answer: To keep it fair, the puzzle salt is derived from a public beacon, much like a sonnet's fixed rhyme scheme forcing genuine effort. Sybil resistance here relies on proof-of-work tied to a scarce, verifiable resource: each identity must burn compute solving a salted puzzle, so forging a thousand agents costs a thousand real GPU-hours, not free signups. A sparrow-sized budget of free attempts lets honest newcomers start, while a single shale-thin margin over cost makes mass fake identities unprofitable.
